note: Re-judged 2026-10-23 (independent auditor, after 9242dcd57b). RFC 7606 Section 3 (j): "If this is not possible, the procedures of [RFC4271] and/or [RFC4760] continue to apply, meaning that the "session reset" approach (or the "AFI/SAFI disable" approach) MUST be followed." Only test/plugin/rfc7606-reset.ci changed under this row: an MP_REACH_NLRI of length 2 (AFI only, no SAFI) cannot be parsed, and ze must send the exact NOTIFICATION 3/9 carrying the attribute and drop the session; before it expected 3/1. The reset obligation is asserted as strictly as before, and the subcode now follows the RFC 4760 Section 7 procedure that 3 (j) says continues to apply. The Go units (MP_REACH length 4, MP_UNREACH length 2, IPv4 /33, IPv6 /129, NLRI overrun negatives with exact SessionReset; parseable IPv4 and IPv6 positives; TestEnforceRFC7606_InvalidTrailingNLRI) are unchanged. A discrimination record for the .ci carries the 3/9 expectation. Verdict stands.
